subject: [PATCH 2/4] btrfs: scrub: cancellable pause during throttle sleep

reviews.author: Qu Wenruo
reviews.summary: Approved the patch with a Reviewed-by tag, indicating that it looks good to them and they've reviewed it.

2026-11-26.patch_summary: This patch improves the scrub throttling semantics in Btrfs by implementing a cancel-aware sleep wrapped in a pause, allowing transactions to proceed unblocked and fixing an issue where scrub throttle sleep ignores attempts to cancel the scrub.
